summary: Iteration 5 tested the two new SPARK enhancements: (A) AI copilot spatial cross-analysis via /api/ai/chat with layer_ids, and (B) Layer Export (per-layer GeoJSON + map PNG). Backend pytest suite (5/5 passing, 47s) validates the point-in-polygon overlay: waste_classes total=344 zones, hotzone_dominant top=Komersial with pct in [38,48] (actual 43%), Critical class dominant=Komersial 100%, and the streamed Claude reply cites Komersial. Frontend end-to-end verified: nav-02 writes spark_active_layers=['builtin-waste-recy','builtin-landuse'] to localStorage, layer-export-builtin-waste-recy downloads 'annual-recyclable-waste.geojson', export-map-image downloads 'sepang-spatial-intelligence.png', and nav-03 suggested-0 streams a grounded EVIDENCE/ANALYSIS/PROJECTION/RECOMMENDATION reply within ~12s that quotes Komersial 100% for Critical, Komersial 43% (335 t) and Pengangkutan 24% (184.7 t) for High+Critical — matching the real overlay from layer_analysis.compute_insights.
critical_code_review_comments: layer_analysis._cache is a module-level global with no lock — safe under uvicorn single worker but if the app is ever scaled to multiple workers each will recompute the ~8-12s overlay independently. Fine for MVP.
layer_context_text always calls compute_insights() even when layer_ids doesn't include either builtin — a tiny wasted call; consider short-circuiting when want_waste and want_landuse are both False.

html-to-image toPng emits benign SecurityErrors when inlining cross-origin Google Fonts / Fontshare CSS — the PNG still downloads correctly, but fonts may fall back in the export. Acceptable, worth documenting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 focused ONLY on: (A) copilot layer-aware answers via /api/ai/chat with layer_ids, and (B) export buttons (per-layer GeoJSON + map PNG). Do not re-test citizen app, planner simulator/forecast/sites/logistics/reports, geo layer CRUD, or basic map rendering. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_layer_ai.py — first run of compute_insights() takes ~8-12s (subsequent calls cached). ai_chat streaming with layer_ids completes within ~15s; Claude replies consistently cite Komersial 100% (Critical) and 43% (High+Critical) plus Pengangkutan 24%.
